name: blind-deboss-toggle
title: Blind Deboss Toggle
description: A tactile switch rendered as typography: the word ON or OFF sits in a soft rubber pad and physically debosses on press — shadows invert, the glyph sinks — a state indicator you can feel with your eyes.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Retro
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Press Toggle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
